subject: Workplace Skills
title: When to Let Connections Go
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: When to Let Connections Go.

hook.text: Not every connection deserves maintenance. Some relationships have expiration dates, and that's perfectly normal.

buildup.text: People change roles, interests, and industries. The connection that was valuable two years ago may not be now.

discovery.text: Let connections fade naturally instead of forcing them. Not every acquaintance needs to become a lifelong contact.

twist.text: Letting go creates space for new connections. A smaller, active network beats a large, neglected one.

climax.text: Focus energy on relationships that are mutual, energizing, and aligned with your current direction.

punchline.text: Prune gently. Active networks beat large dead ones.

quiz.question: Why is it okay to let some professional connections fade?
options: You should never let connections fade
Letting go creates space for new, more aligned connections
